auditFailureMeans: The candidate lock has published advisory matches; this is not a build or compatibility test failure.

fullTree.interpretation: Package-entry counts aggregate dependency-tree nodes and can repeat the same advisory; they are not counts of unique flaws, reachable product paths, or exploitable product behavior.

omitDevAudit.interpretation: This filters dependencies classified as dev by npm; it does not prove which code enters a mini-program bundle or runs in production. The Taro packages remain in this candidate's non-dev dependency graph.

stableReleaseCheck.conclusion: No newer stable Taro 4 release or prerelease package-metadata change resolving the identified Swiper, Webpack peer, or remote-template dependency paths was found. Beta metadata is not a production fix.

reviewedPaths.conditionalUse: Taro remote Git template download/extraction path; not loaded by the recorded local weapp build. download-git-repo clone mode also depends on git-clone@0.1.0.
reviewedPaths.upstreamStatus: The unscoped decompress 4.2.1 line is unmaintained and has no patched version in the reviewed GitHub Advisory records.

forkCandidate.maintenanceEvidence: Published fix releases 10.2.2/11.1.4 are named by GHSA-hrh2-vp3x-79xf.
forkCandidate.compatibilityStatus: Not a verified drop-in for the installed CommonJS download@7.1.0 consumer, which uses require('decompress') and calls the returned value as a function. No override or behavior change was made.

localBuildEvidence.scope: isolated synthetic weapp page without product content

reviewedPaths.conclusion: The observed synthetic weapp bundle did not include the Swiper JS runtime. This does not resolve the advisory for all product import paths or replace the required product-bundle review. Taro's reviewed 4.3.2-beta.2 metadata still pins 11.1.15.

latestVersionOverrideExperiment.decision: Rejected; the override breaks the Taro weapp build despite succeeding at install.

limits: Synthetic preparation pages only; no product pages or real-device interaction were tested.

minimumPatchedOverrideExperiment.decision: Isolated candidate only; user confirmed keeping webpack 5.91.0 to match Taro's exact peer declaration, so webpack 5.104.1 is not adopted. No product-page interaction validation was performed.

normalWeappBuildLoadTrace.interpretation: The CLI statically loads its template helper and downloader dependencies, but this existing-project weapp build did not supply a remote template source or execute the template-fetch command. The trace is scoped to this synthetic build path and is not a product-bundle or general exploitability proof.

reviewedPaths.conclusion: The 5.112.2 override is incompatible. The minimum common patched candidate 5.104.1 passes shared strict typecheck and synthetic weapp/web builds, but violates Taro's published exact webpack peer value and has no product-page or interaction validation. The user confirmed keeping webpack 5.91.0; do not adopt the override. The synthetic weapp load trace scopes conditional tooling paths only; remaining advisories are not marked fixed.

reuseDecision.existingImplementation: Continue the already tested Taro 4.3.1/React 18.3.1 local candidate and its official mini component mapping; no replacement framework adopted.
reuseDecision.scopeChanges: No package versions, manifest, or dependency overrides changed in this review.
reuseDecision.licenseAndMaintenance: The reviewed Taro packages declare MIT. Swiper and the decompress fork declare MIT in npm metadata. The old decompress package is explicitly unmaintained in its advisory; the fork has published patched releases. License metadata is not a complete distribution notice.
reuseDecision.validation: Fresh npm audit against npmjs.org, npm package metadata checks, installed source review, and the previously recorded isolated weapp build/module graph. No exploit reproduction, remote template download, production build, or dependency update was performed.

decision.reason: No compatible stable Taro 4 dependency set resolving the reviewed advisory paths has been verified; current product bundle does not yet exist for reachability review. Keep the user-adopted candidate as an isolated preparation candidate only.
decision.userConfirmedDependencyChoice: keep webpack 5.91.0 to match the exact Taro peer; do not adopt the override
decision.nextAction: The user confirmed keeping webpack@5.91.0 to match Taro's published exact peer; do not adopt the isolated webpack@5.104.1 override.
